summary: Instantiate approved research through one science binding path and retire installed acquisition and Classic alternatives.
details: Bind source-owned and parameterized science declarations to actual typed recipes, unlocks and laboratory inputs; propagate finite research references without constructing factory-acquisition proofs.

Keep the existing catalogue, target adapters and authoritative emitter. Saved Full/Classic setting values share the same generation path; the former Classic generator and four science-discovery modules are excluded from player packages.

Unknown or ambiguous relevant bindings remain explicit. They neither invoke the retired solver nor silently remove established research; retained launch-policy exclusions are distinguished from physical impossibility.
Controlled graph, common-emitter and captured-prototype checks are source evidence. Actual destination upgrades, native performance and client behavior remain required before release.
